title: Introduce lightweight HMR RAG playground with WASM tool shim
author: Maya Li
description: Motivation: speed up developer feedback loops for RAG workflows by providing a tiny, browser-first playground that supports hot module reload (HMR), structured-output contract assertions, and a lightweight WASM tool shim so front-end engineers can prototype tool-calling without a full backend. This PR adds a self-contained example that integrates Redwood telemetry probes and a minimal smoke harness for CI. What this PR contains: - examples/hmr-rag-playground: a small demo app (vanilla TS + Vite) that runs a local RAG loop against a mocked embedding/indexer and a configurable model endpoint (can point at Redwood Hosted or a local dev proxy). - WASM tool shim: a Rust-based wasm-build that compiles to a small tool stub exposing two tool endpoints (fetch-json, compute-score). The stub runs in the browser worker so tool-calling can be exercised without network services. - HMR support: Vite config and devcontainer to enable hot reload of prompt templates, tool bindings, and UI components. - Structured-output assertions: inline prompt-driven contract tests (json-schema snippets) that run in the browser and surface failures to the console and CI. - Telemetry probes: example Redwood Console probe snippets (traces + events) to show how to capture token and latency breakdowns from a RAG session. Usage notes: - Local quickstart: repo/examples/hmr-rag-playground/README.md includes step-by-step: `pnpm install`, `pnpm dev`, open http://localhost:5173`, toggle WASM mode vs remote-mode. - CI smoke: minimal GitHub Actions workflow runs the headless playthrough and asserts structured-output expectations. Checklist: - [x] Add playground app and README - [x] Add wasm tool shim and build script - [x] Add devcontainer and HMR config - [x] Add CI smoke workflow - [x] Add docs snippet for docs site (usage and telemetry) Related: ENG-1294 (developer HMR experiment), PM-402 (quickstart roadmap). Backwards compatibility: example only; no runtime or API code changed. Security: wasm stub runs client-side and does not persist secrets; README includes guidance about not embedding API keys in browser builds. Merge notes: squash-merged after CI green and 2 approvals.

release_notes: Add browser-first RAG playground with hot-reload, WASM tool shim, and structured-output assertion harness. Intended for developer onboarding and quick experimentation; not for production use.
smoke_instructions: 1) cd examples/hmr-rag-playground 2) pnpm install 3) pnpm dev (opens at localhost:5173) 4) run pnpm ci-smoke to execute headless assertions; set REMOTE_MODEL_ENDPOINT env to test against Redwood Hosted API
supporting_comments: Design rationale: small surface area so frontend engineers can iterate on prompt structure, tool contracts, and telemetry without spinning up backend services. The WASM approach keeps tool calling realistic (worker-based) while avoiding cross-origin server complexity.
